cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may test a grape for us before we buy. I've approved your judgment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you read that sign? No tasting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I permit one exception, beginning with you. If nobody objects, I'll have one too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine, but hold the bunch where the assistant can see you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request for a public tasting is granted. I'll present the bunch; you may demonstrate first. I shall be the second opinion.

reason: Replace generic authority with a claimed tasting exemption, and let B demand for visible participation cause A staged demonstration that still puts B first.
